name: How does Hometelligent Inc. handle project supervision during exterior painting?
description: A dedicated project manager supervises daily, conducts quality checks, manages the crew, and communicates with homeowners, providing a single point of contact.

mainEntity.name: How does Hometelligent Inc. handle project supervision during exterior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent Inc. assigns a dedicated project manager to oversee all exterior painting projects. This manager is responsible for daily site visits, quality checks, crew management, and direct communication with the homeowner. This hands-on supervision ensures that work progresses according to plan, safety standards are met, and any issues are addressed promptly. It provides process clarity by having a single point of contact for all project-related inquiries.
